pinned_augmented.definition: lambda is an explicit extra unknown and alpha times relative current error is an explicit extra residual row
pinned_augmented.flux_block: full flux residual direction rescaled so its Euclidean norm equals the exact clipped-cell area-weighted grid L2 norm divided by the instantaneous flux span
pinned_augmented.route: host Jacobian-free Newton-Krylov with Armijo search
pinned_augmented.unknowns_and_rows: N flux unknowns plus lambda and N flux rows plus one current row

pinned_eliminated.definition: lambda = target Ip / unscaled clipped-support Ip at every map evaluation; lambda multiplies all current moments
pinned_eliminated.route: host Jacobian-free Newton-Krylov with Armijo search
pinned_eliminated.unknowns_and_rows: N flux unknowns and N flux residual rows

unpinned.representative_current_comparison: remeasure shipped-20 and full-24 from the same seed per frame

lambda_guard.policy: no clipping: evaluation raises LambdaOutOfBand and the arm records a loud guard termination

low_current_control_fixture.role: selection-defect control only; excluded from every cohort statistic and constrained solve because seed lambda is negative

selection.polarity_screen: every selected shot is absent from the landed 603-shot population
selection.rule: one maximum-absolute-current banked diverted frame per distinct shot, absolute recorded Ip at least 200 kA, retained only when target Ip and extracted unscaled source Ip have the same sign

shared_inputs.current_set: nineteen shipped poloidal currents plus five recovered currents; the shipped bcoil channel supplies the toroidal-field function
shared_inputs.seed: the same convention-clean labelled branch seed in every arm

spectral_estimate.method: central-difference map action inside fixed-count power iteration

target_current.inference_availability: admissible competition input and may also be supplied by a partner transport solve
target_current.source: magnetics_plasma_current interpolated at the labelled time
target_current.status: declared constraint, not a fitted coefficient
target_current.unit_crossing: recorded kA multiplied by 1000 exactly once
